newsitem.title: JAPAN: Idemitsu to lower May oil product wholesale prices.
newsitem.headline: Idemitsu to lower May oil product wholesale prices.

text.p: Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would lower its oil product wholesale prices by 0.7 yen per litre effective from May 1, reflecting declining global crude oil prices.
Following the change, the wholesale price for gasoline will be 90.7 yen per litre while gas oil will be 68.80 yen, both including tax, Idemitsu said.
Kerosene, which is not taxed at the retail level, will be priced at 36.7 yen per litre, Idemitsu said.
Major Japanese refiners review their wholesale prices on a monthly basis and adjust them according to movements in global crude oil, petroleum product and currency markets.
